description:
UI Developer with Vaadin or Google Web Toolkit 
 Richardson, TX – Westland. 
 6+Months 
 Need GC and USC 
 UI developer with Vaadin which is very niche. If they don’t have Vaadin, Google web toolkit is ok. 
 Top Three Skills: 
 1. Vaadin (Google Web Toolkit acceptable)
 2. CSS/HTML
 3. JavaScript 
 Job Description: 
 This position includes the following duties. Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.
 Designs, modifies, develops, writes and implements software programming applications.
 Supports and/or installs software applications.
 Participates in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.
 Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
 May provide consultation on complex projects and is considered to be the top level contributor/specialist.
 A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.
 May report to a team lead or Architect.
 Experience and Skills: 
 Qualifications/Requirements: 
 2 years’ experience working with Vaadin framework or other MVP (Model, View, Presenter) framework (ZK, GWT)
 Deep knowledge of CSS3
 Experience with HTML5
 Demonstrate experience building responsive applications
 Demonstrate capability manipulating complex CSS files


 If you are interested please share your resume to  preethib @usmsystems(dot)com   or can directly call me on  703 468 0398
